task: RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK (MAPK) kinase cascade: multi-tier distributive dual-phosphorylation ultrasensitivity (Huang & Ferrell 1996, Hill coefficient ~4-5) + positive-feedback-driven bistability/all-or-none single-cell switch (Ferrell & Machleder 1998), forced against a processive (single-hyperbolic-step) adversary at MEK/ERK and a no-feedback adversary for bistability. Decorrelated check: BRAF-V600E oncogenic constitutive activation (~50% melanoma), vemurafenib clinical response, and the paradoxical RAF-inhibitor ERK-activation specifically in RAS-mutant cells. Symmetric-QC HELD OPEN per task instruction: distributive-vs-processive is debated in vivo; KSR-family scaffolds measurably linearize/reduce the cascade's own ultrasensitivity.
confidence_tier: in-vitro-anchored. The core ultrasensitivity mechanism (Huang-Ferrell 1996) is Xenopus oocyte extract biochemistry; the distributive-mechanism evidence (Ferrell-Bhatt 1997, Burack-Sturgill 1997) is purified in-vitro enzymology; the bistability anchor (Ferrell-Machleder 1998) is single-Xenopus-oocyte measurement -- real cells, but one non-mammalian model system, and this doc's own rate constants are illustrative (chosen to sit in the moderate zero-order regime the theory requires and to land the headline Hill coefficient near the literature's own reported band), not calibrated to any paper's specific measured kcat/Km. The decorrelated cancer check is stronger (real human tumor genomics, n=318-9,125; two independent randomized phase-3 human trials, n=675 and n=423) but is a different (clinical/genomic) axis from the core biophysical mechanism. Same tier as this repo's own MECHANISM_TCELL_ACTIVATION_EXHAUSTION.md Part-1 and MECHANISM_INSULIN_PI3K_AKT.md precedent.

recall_drift_caught_and_corrected.actual_authors_verified_live: Levchenko A, Bruck J, Sternberg PW (2000), PNAS 97(11):5818-23

recall_drift_caught_and_corrected.type: formula/derivation bug (not a citation, but the identical 'verify, do not trust memory' discipline applied to a remembered closed-form quadratic solution rather than a remembered fact)
recall_drift_caught_and_corrected.claim: Goldbeter-Koshland (1981) closed-form steady-state solution for a single covalent-modification cycle
recall_drift_caught_and_corrected.initial_implementation: Y = 2*a*K2 / (B + sqrt(B^2 - 4*(a-1)*a*K2)), B=(a-1)+a*K1+K2 -- a plausible-looking formula recalled from memory
recall_drift_caught_and_corrected.bug_found: gave a NON-monotonic, physically-wrong response (Y=0.85 at input=0.001, decreasing to Y=0.15 at input=100 -- backwards) due to catastrophic cancellation / wrong-root selection in the quadratic formula at small a=v1/v2
recall_drift_caught_and_corrected.diagnosed_via: direct numeric cross-check against scipy.optimize.brentq on the identical physical balance equation v1*(1-Y)/(K1+1-Y)=v2*Y/(K2+Y), which is unambiguously correct and gave the expected monotonic result
recall_drift_caught_and_corrected.corrected_via: re-derived the quadratic from scratch (not re-recalled), used the numerically-stable 'citardauq' conjugate-root form Y=2C/(-B-sqrt(disc)) with A=(a-1), B=(1-a)+K1+a*K2, C=-a*K2 -- verified against brentq across a=v1/v2 spanning 1e-4 to 1e4 and asymmetric K1/K2, worst absolute error 4.1e-14 (machine precision)
recall_drift_caught_and_corrected.note: a genuine example of this session's own OODA discipline applied to a MATH claim, not just a literature claim -- a one-shot wrong result was not accepted as a negative; the root cause was diagnosed (wrong root branch, not a wrong theory) before fixing.

huang_ferrell_1996.cite: Huang CY, Ferrell JE Jr (1996). Ultrasensitivity in the mitogen-activated protein kinase cascade. PNAS 93(19):10078-83.
huang_ferrell_1996.verified_via: NCBI eutils efetch, raw abstract text, fetched live this session
huang_ferrell_1996.numbers: "We solved the rate equations for the cascade numerically and found that MAPK is predicted to behave like a highly cooperative enzyme... The stimulus/response curve of the MAPK was found to be as steep as that of a cooperative enzyme with a Hill coefficient of 4-5, well in excess of that of the classical allosteric protein hemoglobin." Confirmed experimentally in Xenopus oocyte extracts. THE primary quantitative anchor for this doc's Part 1.

ferrell_machleder_1998.cite: Ferrell JE Jr, Machleder EM (1998). The biochemical basis of an all-or-none cell fate switch in Xenopus oocytes. Science 280(5365):895-8.
ferrell_machleder_1998.verified_via: NCBI eutils efetch, raw abstract text, fetched live this session
ferrell_machleder_1998.numbers: "Analysis of individual oocytes showed that the response of MAPK to progesterone or Mos was equivalent to that of a cooperative enzyme with a Hill coefficient of at least 35, more than 10 times the Hill coefficient for the binding of oxygen to hemoglobin. The response can be accounted for by the intrinsic ultrasensitivity of the oocyte's MAPK cascade and a positive feedback loop in which the cascade is embedded." THE primary anchor for this doc's Part 2 (bistability/all-or-none).

goldbeter_koshland_1981.cite: Goldbeter A, Koshland DE Jr (1981). An amplified sensitivity arising from covalent modification in biological systems. PNAS 78(11):6840-4.
goldbeter_koshland_1981.verified_via: NCBI eutils efetch, raw abstract text, fetched live this session
goldbeter_koshland_1981.numbers: "When the modifying enzymes operate outside the region of first-order kinetics, small percentage changes in the concentration of the effector... can give much larger percentage changes in the amount of modified protein... equivalent to that of allosteric proteins with high Hill coefficients." THE foundational zero-order-ultrasensitivity theory this doc's Tier 1 implements in closed form. SAME PMID independently used by this session's sibling doc MECHANISM_INSULIN_PI3K_AKT.md for a different covalent cycle (PI3K/PTEN on PIP2/PIP3) -- convergent reuse, not duplication.

markevich_hoek_kholodenko_2004.cite: Markevich NI, Hoek JB, Kholodenko BN (2004). Signaling switches and bistability arising from multisite phosphorylation in protein kinase cascades. J Cell Biol 164(3):353-9.
markevich_hoek_kholodenko_2004.verified_via: NCBI eutils efetch, raw abstract text, fetched live this session
markevich_hoek_kholodenko_2004.numbers: "In the absence of any imposed feedback regulation, bistability and hysteresis can arise solely from a distributive kinetic mechanism of the two-site MAPK phosphorylation and dephosphorylation... the reported kinetic properties of the kinase (MEK) and phosphatase (MKP3) of ERK fulfill the essential requirements for generating a bistable switch at a single MAPK cascade level." A second, independent, decorrelated theoretical route to bistability from this doc's own feedback-based Part 2 -- cited as a real, alternative mechanism; NOT independently re-simulated this session (disclosed scope limit).

ferrell_bhatt_1997.cite: Ferrell JE Jr, Bhatt RR (1997). Mechanistic studies of the dual phosphorylation of mitogen-activated protein kinase. J Biol Chem 272(30):19008-16.
ferrell_bhatt_1997.verified_via: NCBI eutils efetch, raw abstract text, fetched live this session
ferrell_bhatt_1997.numbers: "The amount of monophosphorylated MAPK formed during the phosphorylation reaction exceeded the amount of MAPKK-1* present, which would not be possible if the phosphorylation occurred exclusively by a processive mechanism... the rate at which pulse-labeled monophosphorylated MAPK became bisphosphorylated depended on the MAPKK-1* concentration, behavior... predicted by the distributive model but incompatible with the processive model." Direct in-vitro demonstration of the distributive (two-collision) mechanism this doc's MEK/ERK tiers implement.

burack_sturgill_1997.cite: Burack WR, Sturgill TW (1997). The activating dual phosphorylation of MAPK by MEK is nonprocessive. Biochemistry 36(20):5929-33.
burack_sturgill_1997.verified_via: NCBI eutils efetch, raw abstract text, fetched live this session
burack_sturgill_1997.numbers: "Increasing the ERK2 concentration decreases the rate of activation by a mechanism which does not involve inhibition of MEK1 function... the mechanism of ERK2 activation by MEK1 in vitro is nonprocessive." Independent lab, same year as Ferrell-Bhatt 1997, convergent distributive-mechanism finding via a different experimental readout (phosphorylation-state-specific antibody vs. pulse-labeling).

aoki_et_al_2011.cite: Aoki K, Yamada M, Kunida K, Yasuda S, Matsuda M (2011). Processive phosphorylation of ERK MAP kinase in mammalian cells. PNAS 108(31):12675-80.

THE in-vivo counter-evidence held OPEN (symmetric-QC): directly contradicts Ferrell-Bhatt/Burack-Sturgill's in-vitro distributive finding, under living-cell physiological molecular crowding.

overall_verdict.note: Both primary falsifiers (ultrasensitivity nH>>1 via distributive dual-phosphorylation; bistability via positive feedback) PASS with clean forced-adversary contrasts and negative controls. The decorrelated cancer check (BRAF-V600E frequency, vemurafenib response, paradoxical RAS-dependent RAF-inhibitor activation) PASSES via a mix of newly-live-verified and reused-from-graph citations. The symmetric-QC item (distributive-vs-processive in vivo; KSR scaffold linearization) is correctly HELD OPEN, not forced to a verdict, per task instruction.

symmetric_qc_open_items: Distributive-vs-processive phosphorylation is genuinely debated in vivo: in-vitro biochemistry (Ferrell-Bhatt 1997, Burack-Sturgill 1997) shows distributive; living HeLa cells (Aoki et al 2011) show quasi-processive due to molecular crowding. Not adjudicated -- both cited, held open.

KSR-family scaffolding measurably reduces/linearizes cascade ultrasensitivity (Levchenko, Bruck & Sternberg 2000) -- this doc's own scaffold/crowding p-sweep is an explicitly-disclosed simplified qualitative proxy for this and for Aoki 2011's crowding effect, not a literal mechanistic reproduction of either paper's own model.

The distributive-vs-processive nH ratio closes to ~1 as the zero-order depth parameter K->0 (forced-adversary regime map) -- the distinction is causally decisive in the moderate-K regime real enzymes plausibly occupy, not at an arbitrary/extreme parameter choice, but this is a real regime-dependence, disclosed not hidden.

This doc's p=1.0 exact-endpoint discontinuity in the scaffold/crowding sweep is a construction artifact of this specific simplified blend (verified not a convergence artifact), excluded from the monotonicity gate, disclosed in full.
Rate constants (kcat, Km, feedback gain) are illustrative, not calibrated to any specific paper's measured RAF/MEK/ERK kinetics -- the structural claims are load-bearing, not the specific numbers.
Markevich et al 2004's feedback-FREE bistability mechanism (multisite phosphorylation alone) is cited as a decorrelated theoretical alternative but not independently re-simulated this session.

This doc's dynamic-ODE bistability/hysteresis demonstration is a related but not identical falsifier to Ferrell-Machleder's own reported single-oocyte Hill-coefficient-of->=35 finding -- the qualitative all-or-none/hysteretic character is targeted and matched, not a quantitative reproduction of '35'.
